description: This file contains functions for building various replay policies for AI models, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, as well as functions for sanitizing and managing turn order markers in chat sessions.

methods.name: buildOpenAICompatibleReplayPolicy
methods.description: Constructs a replay policy based on the specified model API string, supporting OpenAI and Azure models.

methods.name: buildStrictAnthropicReplayPolicy
methods.description: Creates a strict Anthropic replay policy with optional dropping of thinking blocks.

methods.name: buildAnthropicReplayPolicyForModel
methods.description: Builds an Anthropic replay policy, dropping thinking blocks if the model ID includes 'claude'.

methods.name: buildHybridAnthropicOrOpenAIReplayPolicy
methods.description: Selects and builds a replay policy based on the context's model API, for either Anthropic or OpenAI.

methods.name: buildGoogleGeminiReplayPolicy
methods.description: Creates a replay policy tailored for Google Gemini models with specific sanitization and validation settings.

methods.name: buildPassthroughGeminiSanitizingReplayPolicy
methods.description: Builds a Gemini replay policy with optional sanitization based on model ID.

methods.name: sanitizeGoogleGeminiReplayHistory
methods.description: Sanitizes Google Gemini replay history, ensuring proper turn ordering markers.

methods.name: resolveTaggedReasoningOutputMode
methods.description: Returns the output mode 'tagged' for reasoning.
